artworks.title: When We Were Boys
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a path winding through a wooded area. The path is earthy and slightly uneven, leading from the foreground to the background. The dense foliage obscures the horizon, with a solitary figure walking in the distance. Tall trees frame the path closely, with their trunks and branches covered in leaves. The image is in sepia tones, with browns and hints of gray. Intricate textures are visible in the bark of the trees and leaves. The scene conveys a sense of tranquil solitude in nature.

artworks.title: A Willow Grows Aslant The Brook
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a nature scene with a grassy field meeting the sky at the horizon. A stream winds through the landscape, with a large tree leaning over it. The tree's bark and foliage are detailed, and the colors are in black and white. In the distance, more trees and sheep can be seen in the fields.

artworks.title: Old Lock at Welford
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a canal lock in operation. A person is pushing the lock gate lever. Water reflects the sky with ripples leading towards a distant mill partially hidden by trees. The horizon includes a line of trees against an overcast sky. The picture is in sepia tones, reminiscent of early photographic styles, creating a classic atmosphere. The foreground has lush foliage and grass contrasting with the water and sky.

artworks.title: First Glimpse of Kenilworth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point of a tranquil scene by a shallow water crossing. An earthen path with wheel and foot marks leads to the water, where a horse-drawn carriage is stopping. A horse drinks from the water, its reflection visible. In the background, a dirt road curves to the right, bordered by a stone wall and wooden fence. Leafless trees with intricate branches line the road, leading to a large structure, possibly a castle, faintly visible in the mist. The horizon is marked by distant trees blending into the gray sky. The color palette is earthy and subdued.

artworks.title: The Old Chair Mender
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a quaint village scene with a thatched cottage at the center. A dirt path curves to the right, leading towards another cottage in the background. The horizon is low, accentuating the cottages and the rural track. The background consists of trees and another house. The image is in sepia tones, giving it a vintage feel. In the foreground, a man sits by a stone wall, working on a task, while three children watch. An elderly man stands in the cottage doorway, observing. In the distance, another figure walks away.

artworks.title: Simplicité
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a young child captured from the waist up in a standing position. The child has curly light hair that frames their face. Their facial features appear soft and calm, with eyes looking directly at the camera. The child is wearing a loose-fitting gown with a ruffled collar and long sleeves. They hold a bundle of peacock feathers in their hands, which are positioned around the waist area. The backdrop is a dark, indistinct background.

artworks.title: Tages Erwachen (The Awakening of the Day)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a misty horizon, waterlogged terrain, and some vegetation. The horizon divides the dark land from the sky, which has a gray, overcast tone. The scene includes pools of water, sediment, grasses, and some taller vegetation along a watercourse leading into the distance. The colors are primarily shades of gray, creating a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Fire in Oxford Street
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a city street with a large crowd, horse-drawn carriages, rising smoke, multi-story buildings, signs, and lamps. The architecture suggests a historical setting, and the sepia tone adds to the aged appearance. The presence of carriages and building style indicate it was taken before automobiles were common. The scene conveys a sense of vibrant city life with movement in the crowd and street activity.

artworks.title: On the Banks of the Wey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside view with a pathway running parallel to a waterway. Tall trees on the right side obscure the horizon, and their reflections can be seen in the water on the left. In the distance, a low tree with sprawling branches leans over the water. The artwork features soft, delicate strokes creating a dreamy effect, and a monochromatic color palette of brown and gray, enhancing the tranquil quality of the landscape.

artworks.title: Das Schweigen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image displays a cluster of tree trunks with a focus on the water beyond where several swans are gliding. The horizon is obscured by the tree forms. The brush strokes appear smooth and soft. The color palette is dominated by deep blues and blacks, creating a serene atmosphere. Lighter tones of the swans create a contrast and draw the eye. The play of light and shadow adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: The Vesper Bell
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly woman seated from the waist up, with her hands clasped near her face, looking downward. She has white hair in a bun, wearing a white blouse, checkered skirt, and a knitted shawl. A ball of yarn and a partial knitting project are on her lap. Next to her, there is a plant on a windowsill.

artworks.title: Roscoff
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point near the edge of a body of water, with a view of a stone structure and buildings aligned along a coastline. The horizon is low with dark silhouettes of the buildings. The image is in sepia tone. The water is dark, reflecting light, leading towards the stone buildings. The sky is overcast, and the scene appears quiet.

artworks.title: Une Matinée
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a serene waterscape with a low angle view near the water level. The horizon is positioned in the middle, and in the distance, there is a grand, domed building and a tall tower surrounded by a soft haze. The style resembles early photography with a slightly grainy texture. The image is in a monochrome sepia tone. A gondola with a gondolier is close to the viewer while two other gondolas can be seen further away. The scene captures a tranquil moment focusing on light and shadow playing across the water and sky.

artworks.title: Le Terril
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an industrial landscape with figures engaged in construction work on a mound of earth beneath a large, wooden structure. The scene is captured in black-and-white, giving it a historical or vintage feel. The photograph showcases an elevated platform in the background with two silhouetted figures standing. The foreground presents rugged terrain with loose earth and rocks, where additional figures appear to be engaged in manual labor. The sky above is cloudy with diffused sunlight casting soft illumination over the workers and construction scene. The composition highlights hard labor and industrialization.

artworks.title: Japanese Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge crossing over water, surrounded by trees and bushes. The scene has a dreamlike quality with a soft, blurred aesthetic. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and gray. A tree trunk dominates the left side of the image, with branches reaching upward and to the right. On the bridge, two figures in flowing garments are visible: one sitting and gazing downward, and the other walking away, slightly out of focus. The background features indistinct trees and foliage, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Silver Skirt
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing, partially turned towards the camera. The figure is dressed in an ornate, flowing garment that appears to be a long dress topped by a draped coat or wrap. They are wearing an elaborate, wide-brimmed hat. Under the hat, hints of curly hair can be seen. Around their neck, there is a ruffled collar. The person's hands are delicately holding or adjusting the fabric of their robe. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held besides the mentioned garment. The background features a softly focused interior space, with the light and shadow play creating a serene and muted tone throughout the image.

artworks.title: Rebecca
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, holding a large shell-like object to their ear with their left hand. They have dark, curly hair and wear a draped garment with a white line or belt-like adornment that ends in a tassel. The background is an artistically rich scene with indistinct figures and soft forms in a shadowy, sepia tone.

artworks.title: The Crystal Gazer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning forward slightly, looking at a glass orb on a table. The person's facial features are unclear due to the angle of the photo. They have dark hair and wear a light-colored garment with intricate embellishments. The background is softly blurred, with no specific details visible.

artworks.title: A Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated with a focus on their upper body, arms, and face. They are in a relaxed position, slightly leaning back with their arms in front. The person has short, dark, straight hair tucked behind the ears. The face is blurred with low contrast, giving an ethereal quality to the portrait. They are wearing a garment with puffy sleeves and a ring on one hand. In the background, there is a textured pattern that may feature leaves and grapes. The overall tone of the image is sepia, creating a vintage feel.

artworks.title: New York Central Yard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a snowy railyard with train tracks converging towards the center and leading into the distance. A large plume of steam hovers above a steam locomotive, positioned beyond the central part of the image. The horizon is obscured by the dark silhouettes of industrial buildings and structures. The style of the image is grainy and textured, resembling early 20th-century photography or printmaking. The print quality is soft and blurred, creating a moody, atmospheric effect. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of gray, black, and white, emphasizing the cold ambiance of the scene. Several figures are faintly visible among the tracks, adding scale and activity to the railway setting.

artworks.title: A Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with mist creating a soft, diffused effect blending the sky with trees in the distance. A tall tree occupies the center, with a figure in a dress on the right side. Soft focus and sepia tones enhance the tranquil mood of the scene.

artworks.title: Towards Snowdonia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a high horizon, distant mountains meeting a cloudy sky, a curved beach with gentle waves, calm waters, patches of vegetation, a textured stone wall, and a small structure among the dunes. The photo features varying shades of gray, creating a serene mood of vast openness and quiet solitude.

artworks.title: Plate 1
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, slightly off-center and facing upwards with hands raised as if pulling a rope. Their facial features are partially obscured by shadow, with determined expression. They have a dark complexion, wearing a white headscarf, white garment with dark embellishments, and a draped scarf over their shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or other objects held by the person. The background includes a light-colored wooden wall and a partially visible door on the left, indicating an indoor setting with diffused lighting and shadows.

artworks.title: Wylie Mill, Chester, South Carolina
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Maurizia Grossman in memory of Sheldon Grossman
